Reserve transparency

xUSDC is issued on Xeris against USDC held in the Solana reserve. Issuance and redemption require verified settlement and recorded reserve obligations.

View USDC reserve

xUSDC is issued by the Xeris treasury. It is a separate asset from Circle-issued USDC. Reserve settlement is operator-managed.

Supply methodology

Circulation, measured.

Includes unlocked genesis allocations, mined wallet balances and active approved AMM inventory. Company and treasury holdings are included; wrapped XRS is counted once.

  • Unlocked genesis allocations included
  • Unlocked mined balances included
  • Burned, staked and locked balances excluded
Scheduled block reward—

Mining totals are not circulating supply. Financial estimates use xUSDC’s intended 1:1 USDC backing as a USD reference, with current FX for other currencies.

Values are published from a consistent on-chain census. Unavailable or expired data is removed until a fresh snapshot arrives.
